tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, data modeling and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, experienced in working within international teams.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the Senior Consultant/Architect position at hmmh AG, bringing over 5 years of professional experience in enterprise e-commerce platforms. Through my roles at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built a strong background in developing, extending, and supporting complex SAP ecosystems.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Solutions
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows across global channels.

bullets.label: Process Optimization
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms, working directly with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, performing code reviews and supporting production issues.

cover_en.gap: While my primary expertise lies in SAP Commerce Cloud rather than SAP Sales & Service Cloud, S/4HANA, FSM, CPQ, or SAP BTP, I have a strong foundational background in SAP platforms and am very keen to learn these additional areas.
cover_en.logistics: I am currently based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, allowing me to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich bei der hmmh AG als Senior Consultant/Architect im SAP CX-Umfeld. Durch meine über 5-jährige professionelle Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Betreuung großer Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Plattformen
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement.

bullets.label: REST-APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Anpassung von Interceptoren, Populatoren und Converters für kundenspezifische Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: Daten- und Systemintegration
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub sowie Behebung von Integrationsengpässen zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee.

bullets.label: Agile Arbeitsweise
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Bereitstellungszyklen und Release-Builds auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) innerhalb agiler DevOps-Workflows.

cover_de.gap: Mein Schwerpunkt liegt auf SAP Commerce Cloud; die im Profil genannten Module wie Sales & Service Cloud, S/4HANA, FSM, CPQ oder SAP BTP gehören zwar noch nicht zu meiner direkten Praxiserfahrung, jedoch bin ich hoch motiviert, mich in diese Bereiche einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: hmmh AG's commitment to creating advanced digital customer experiences and strong positioning in the digital commerce landscape makes it an ideal place to apply my 5+ years of SAP enterprise platform experience. I am eager to contribute my technical background in Java, Spring, and integrations to your innovative projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, backend expertise in Java and Spring, and strong background in enterprise integrations to hmmh AG's dynamic projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a backend developer with 5+ years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and enterprise integrations. As I am currently based in Germany and looking for my next opportunity starting 16.12.2026, I would love to connect regarding the Senior Consultant/Architect role at hmmh AG.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Senior Consultant/Architect position at hmmh AG. With over 5 years of professional experience in developing and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms, Java, and complex API integrations, I am eager to bring my technical background to your team.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my skills match your requirements in an interview.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
